conditions.question: Who has to reconstruct this reasoning without the author present?
Can this step be undone, and at what cost?
How settled is the bet this work rests on?

enablement.action: decide which kind of person, in which circumstance, to design the solution for
enablement.actor: whoever designs the solution or studies the people it is for

guidance.claim: Distinct from User / Job Stories: a job holds whatever solution is chosen; a story says what the solution lets a person do. A when / want / so-that line written before any solution exists states a job.
Jobs are circumstance-anchored and stable. Solutions churn; jobs do not.
The when / want / so-that job-story form captures circumstance better than persona-attached stories.

sections.name: Jobs to be done
sections.question: What is a person trying to achieve?

guidance.claim: Osterwalder's value-proposition-canvas pairing — pains before, gains after.
Distinct from Problem Statement: this records what each segment finds frustrating and hopes for, many entries drawn from evidence; Problem Statement names the one problem the work chooses to solve.
Distinct from Jobs to Be Done: the job is the progress itself; pains are what gets in the way of making it today, and gains are what would make it better.
Source from evidence — interviews, support logs — not empathy-map guessing. Rank by severity times frequency or the list flattens.

sections.name: Pains and gains
sections.question: What frustrations and hoped-for gains does each segment have?

guidance.claim: Segment by shared job or behaviour, not demographics alone — demographic-only segments are the classic false-precision trap.
In B2B the buyer, the user and the payer differ; healthtech's patient/provider/payer triangle makes single-segment framing misleading.
One beachhead segment. A long segment list this early signals unvalidated focus.

Distinct from Canonical Model: a segment here is a group of people the offering is for; a category there is one the system uses to sort its own data, such as account types. Ask whether it is about whom we serve or how the system files things.

sections.name: Customer segments
sections.question: Exactly which groups is the offering for?

guidance.claim: A user story (as-a / I-want / so-that) presumes a persona; a job story (when / I-want / so-I-can) presumes a circumstance. Pick one per document; do not mix.
Acceptance criteria turn a story from a conversation-starter into testable scope.
Distinct from Jobs to Be Done: ask whether the line names what the solution must let a person do. A story does, and acceptance criteria test it; the job behind it stays true whatever is built.

sections.name: User job stories
sections.question: What should the solution let a person do?

guidance.claim: Cover every stage at which the offering meets the segment: how they hear of it, weigh it up, buy it, receive it and get support afterwards.
Product-led versus sales-led growth is at bottom a channels choice. Regulated and enterprise markets often have imposed channels — brokers, distributors, procurement — that dominate the design.
For physical goods, delivery and service channels drive cost structure. Link the two.

sections.name: Channels
sections.question: How does the offering reach each segment?
